contract: The DoltLite beta chunk-store format version is 12
Version 12 writers emit working-set format v5
Version 12 writers emit catalog format v5
Version 12 writers emit refs format v7
Version 12 writers emit commit format v2
Header versions other than 12 fail normally with SQLITE_NOTADB
A wrong chunk-store magic fails normally with SQLITE_NOTADB
The frozen version 12 corpus has a checked checksum and generation recipe
The frozen version 12 corpus preserves rows secondary indexes schema and integrity
The frozen version 12 corpus preserves commit branch and tag refs
A current version 12 writer can extend commit reopen and garbage-collect the frozen corpus
